items.heading: High Score
items.text: High score: You talk to real customers before you build, listen for the problem behind the request, follow up politely and treat a no as information.

items.heading: Low Score
items.text: Low score: You plan or build first and talk to customers later, or asking for money feels so awkward that you lower the price or stay silent.
